programme.desc: A chauffeurs daughter and the heir to a cruise ship conglomerate fall in love as they try to outwit greedy relatives who have sights on the company.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: A man comes across a secret list of anti-Ching rebel names and quickly becomes a target for Ching loyalists.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu moves to Hong Kong, a kind-hearted fellow from rural China is taken advantage by cunning characters including his uncle.

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Watch as rival kung-fu schools try to sabotage Fei-hungs superior Pao Chih Lin clinic until the chivalrous philanthropist shows them the error of their ways.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: Director Anthony Chan joins award-winning social satirist Alfred Cheung Kin Ting in this delightful variation on the hugely successful British Carry On!

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: At first, a gang just wants the village locksmith to open a stolen safe, but it soon escalates into wholesale torment when they are met with resistance.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: This gender-bending tale depicts the romance between a wealthy girl and a man disguised as a flunkey in order to be employed at her house.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: Witness the exploits of Chan Chao an advocate of justice who thwarts the plans of Minister Peng to assassinate the revered Judge Pao Cheng over and over again.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Adapted from Chiung Yaos novel, this romance depicts how a wealthy man and a sweet girl discover that they are soulmates too late in life.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: A wine shop owners son, who finds a brilliant martial arts coach in his private tutor, foils a plan by a thief but what happens when he returns for revenge?

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Lauded as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals of the 60s, this award-winning piece starring Linda Lin Dai as a dancer who finds romance with her bosss son.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: An alluring female fairy seeks love among mortals and finds it in a man who takes care of an orphanage.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: A beauty is accused of slaying her boyfriends. After fleeing to Lantau Island, she seduces another man there.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Two ingenious lovebirds come up with what they think is a fool proof plan to get their parents to allow them to wed. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Award-winning actor Ku Feng plays the cunning pirate Lei Chen-tien, flanked by Wan Ping who disguises herself as a boy to beat him to the treasure.

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei turns human combine harvester as she hacks a path through life, avenging the death of her family under the moniker The Jade Raksha.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays a beauty tricked into sacrificing herself for the good of the Chinese people. However, the truth is revealed too late.

programme.title: Song of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei exchanges her martial arts weaponry for a syringe in this exotic contemporary drama by Pan Lei.

programme.title: Heads for Sale
programme.desc: Chiao Chiao stars in the popular tale of a decapitating swordswoman who will let nothing stand in her way when she falls in love with a bandits son.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: When deadbeats Ming and Liang stumble upon records of scandals involving government officials, what follows is a humorous misadventure of epic proportions.

programme.title: Legend of the Fox
programme.desc: This exciting tale of revenge features cameos from the directors three most popular Venoms, Kuo Chue, Chiang Sheng and Lu Feng.

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: The peaceful life of Golden Swallow is shattered when her unrequited suitor, Silver Roc, begins a killing spree to draw her out of seclusion. Stars Cheng Pei Pei, Jimmy Wang Yu.

programme.title: The Shadows Edge
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves steals billions, outsmarting the Sky Eye surveillance system. The Macau police enlist retired expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild the elite squad and hunt down the mastermind.

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: Stephen Chow stars in this parody on the popular Judge Pao stories, depicting how he helps a rape victim fight the system against corrupt lawyers officials.

programme.title: Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: A family torn apart 8 years ago during a disastrous winter solstice dinner reunites when their cousin returns home from England, hoping to mend relations after things had fallen apart.

programme.title: My Wife Is A Gambling Maestro
programme.desc: Gambling queen, Ying Ying who is a contender for the Asian God of Gamblers competition and rescued by Gerrard but suffering from amnesia, she decided recover in time to compete in the big event!

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Ming falls into coma and is transported to a fantasy realm where old Master Turtle teaches him ancient boxing skill to defeat an evil boss. Meanwhile, Mings mother finds a way to save her son.

programme.title: Victims
programme.desc: After a ruthless Kuala Lumpur student murders his classmate, the victims mother and the killers mother uncover hidden truths about their sons and face very different paths of grief and torment.

programme.title: Back To The Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lived in seclusion for 20 years until a time traveller returned to rewrite history, forcing them to defend the Qin dynasty and fate itself.

programme.title: The Sunny Side of the Street
programme.desc: A Pakistani refugee receive help from a taxi driver after his father died in a car crash. They gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the truth behind his fathers death.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Eddie Peng charms as possibly the most handsome Monkey King alongside Shawn Yue Ni Ni in this fantasy-action-adventure film.

programme.title: Guilt By Design
programme.desc: As a juror in a high-profile case learns that his daughter has been mysteriously kidnapped, he must decide whether to use his special skills to influence the trial as demanded by the kidnappers.

programme.title: The White Storm 2 Drug Lords
programme.desc: In this epic action-thriller starring Andy Lau Louis Koo, a bounty of USD 100 million awaits those who successfully capture the biggest drug dealer in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba turns his mothers chili sauce into a trendy commodity during the pandemic, with the help of the whole family. The business booms online, bringing them unexpected success and unity.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: Based on the 1954 martial arts novel, this film details the tragic romance between wild swordsman Zhuo Yi-hang and rival cult assassin Lien Ni-chang, with a dark, erotic and visually stunning twist.

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica falls for an online dating app scam with young Joe, who poses as a French engineer. What begins as a romance built on lies ultimately transforms two seemingly mismatched souls.

programme.title: Everything is Unknown
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming must attend his fathers funeral to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and her family, but ended up falling into their trap.

programme.title: Demi-Haunted
programme.desc: Starring Eason Chan, Joey Yung Nicholas Tse, this dark comedy depicts the spirit of a Chinese opera singer who returns to perform a final song for her lover.

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: Three devastated parents unite after their children are abducted. Driven by grief and rage, they hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate to bring their children home alive.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: After being discovered flirting with his boss daughter, Sing gets blown up, but later gets relived as his professor transforms him to be a cyborg of household products.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis, his marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him.

programme.title: Measure In Love
programme.desc: A massive quake splits the world into two zones with different time speeds. Medical student An Qing meets a boy named Shu Zai, yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged.

programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the familys young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huos stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Huis husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders, it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dongs songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his fathers death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind...

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the mens help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Clouds successor as the citys guard.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the others mole.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from The Sutra of 42 Chapters.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Taos house became haunted. Years later, Master Taos descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewifes debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Lis daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggars gang when he saves the gangs elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous Gang Trio is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three Rob-B-Hood must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.desc: The barbababies find a lost baby elephant and secretly look after it. How will Barbapapa and Barbamama react to Boris? Boris the elephant misses home. The Barbapapa decide to bring him back to Africa. On the spot, they help Boris to acclimatize.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - Making Bread From One Pit to Another
programme.desc: Barbapapa wants to teach his children to make bread, but things dont go as planned... The Barbababies plant an avocado tree. However, it takes years before the first harvest. Barbabright has an idea to save time that may well lead to...disaster.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 - Present Movie Vinny
programme.desc: Tim, Tommy and Tia cant decide on the best gift for Grandma. Tim tries to make his own Captain DinoStar movie. Tim fakes it to prove hes just as cool as Kais cousin.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 - Explorer Happy Parky Storm
programme.desc: Tim explores Rumbleton to find somewhere he can have fun alone. Tim and Kai try to give Parky the best day ever. When a storm keeps the Rexes at home they must think of a game to pass the time.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 - Super Dad Time Out Cookies
programme.desc: Tim sets out to prove Kais Dad is Captain DinoStar Tim tries to relax, but Tia has other ideas Tim gets the best cookies in town but soon finds that others need them more than him

programme.title: Rubble Crew S2 - The Crew Builds A Roller CoasterThe Crew Builds Motor A Play Space
programme.desc: When Speed Meisters rollercoaster sends a pet playdate out of control, Rubble Crew save the day with a bigger, better, and safer coaster. The Bark Yard safety inspection is today! But will Motor go boom and cost the Crew a gold safety star?

programme.title: Rubble Crew S2 - The Crew Builds A Train Station The Crew Builds A Sierra Sparkle Sign
programme.desc: Rubble Crew build the first train station in Builder Cove just in time to welcome Farmer Zoes new cow Mooreen. Popstar Sierra Sparkle is moving to Builder Cove! But when the pups plan a surprise greeting, Speed Meister makes a plan of his own.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S10 - Pups Save a Baby Caribou Pups Save Luke and His Luke-Alike
programme.desc: When a baby caribou winds up speeding down a mountainside. Its up to the PAW Patrol to save the calf and reunite him with his family. When Luke Stars gets blown away in a giant tumbleweed, Digi and Tal make a duplicate which dances out of control.

programme.title: Deer Squad S1 - Captain Steel Wash Out
programme.desc: Whilst some of the Deer Squad down with flu, Sir Steel tries to become a superhero with disastrous results. Sir Steel borrows water from Crystal Lake for his Water Park in the city, but things soon go wrong!

programme.title: DORA S5 - Mami Day Pet Day
programme.desc: Dora travels across the rainforest to get a gift for Mami. Along the way, she helps her friends make gifts for their mommies too. Dora and Boots throw a party to celebrate Pet Day and show the all the rainforest pets just how much they love them.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 - Tritons Trumpet The Curse of the Pirate Baby
programme.desc: Santiago and crew must retrieve a powerful undersea artifact after its stolen by Enrique. Bonnie Bones transforms into a baby and its up to the good pirates to change her back.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 - Moon Cow Nebulator Space Bug
programme.desc: Tim, Tommy Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner. Kai is super excited to ride the Nebulator, but Tim isnt so sure. Tim and Kai try to photograph the illusive SpaceBug.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 - Time Out
programme.desc: Tim tries to relax, but Tia has other ideas.

programme.title: Ben Hollys Little Kingdom S1 - The Elf Factory Acorn Day
programme.desc: It is almost Christmas and the elves are busy making toys. When there is a problem, a little bit of magic saves the day. Squirrels appear at the Great Elf Tree, determined to store acorns inside it, but the Wise Old Elf has other ideas.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - Ah! My Beautiful Castle The Sand Is Running Away
programme.desc: During a bike ride, the Barbapapa family discovers an old medieval castle in ruins. Barbapapa and Lolita were traveling in a balloon, but caught in a storm they ended up stranded on a deserted island.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - The Birth The Revelation
programme.desc: Young Francois witnesses the birth of Barbapapa. Barbapapa is a prisoner in a zoo.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - The Barbapapa Family The House of Barbapapa
programme.desc: Barbapapa finds refuge in the house that Francois parents built for him. The house of Barbapapa is far too small now that Barbamama and the Barbabebe have arrived in his life.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 - Big Help Croc Pom Pom
programme.desc: Mr. Crocodile volunteers to help too many friends with their projects all at the same time. Daisy and Mr. Crocodile invite a new friend, PomPom, to live with them.

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1 - The Mysterious Fruit Thief The Riddle of the Wrestling Lizards
programme.desc: Someones snatching all the fruit from an orangutans island in the jungle. The agents try to bring some peace to a pair of brawling gila monsters.

programme.title: Rubble Crew S4 - The Crew Builds a Giant Checkerboard The Crew Builds a Corn Silo
programme.desc: Coach Karima is throwing Checkers Day for all the Builder Cove kids! But when everyone cant play together, Rubble Crew save the day with construction. Rubble and Wheeler team up to construct a solution for a mysterious mess on Farmer Zoes farm.

programme.title: Rubble Crew S4 - The Crew Builds A Soap Box Derby The Crew Builds A Bird Flight School

programme.desc: When the Dizzy Dust Express appears with no one aboard, the Paw Patrol must stop the runaway train and find the missing passengers. Ms. Marjorie, Tilly Turbot, and Mayor Goodway get stranded in the treetops on their jungle zip-lining adventure.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - The Barbababies Have Got Talent Triple Switcheroo
programme.desc: Every barbababy is invited to show their greatest talent on stage. Video games are fun, but you also need to know how to enjoy the nice weather!

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 - Deep Freeze The Trojan Seahorse
programme.desc: The biggest party of the year could be cancelled after Escarlata la Pirata freezes the high seas! Bonnie Bones is on the run with the museums priceless treasures, but Santi and crew wont let her get far.

programme.desc: In order to win the Citizen of the Year, Sir Steel and Professor Scratch create holograms doubles of Deer Squad who cause chaos all around. Its Recycling Day and Sir Steel puts the whole town in cardboard boxes with his Box-ooka device.

programme.title: 试真D唷 Try It? Really? Sr.2

programme.title: 女神配对计划2 A Date with Goddess Sr.2
programme.desc: 恋爱真人骚女神配对计划火热回归，第二季恋爱战场全面升级！金牌媒人Bob林盛斌招募全球男士，为女神何沛珈郭佩文陈若思俞可程阮嘉敏开展恋爱配对求爱勇者接受心动揿灯五角枱约会等挑战，各出奇谋冧女神一对一亲密游戏引爆心跳警报，还有隐藏女神加入战团，火花进一步升温更多求爱考验来临，勇者们力求走到最后，攻陷女神心！此外，上季五位女神与星级嘉宾们轮流成为花生团，直击女神约会实况.

programme.title: 一周星星 Star Weekly

programme.title: 美食新闻周报 Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食！黄嘉雯倪嘉雯伍倩彤等美食主播主持，紧贴最新美食潮流，从不同平台网罗超人气餐厅消息，主持亲自试食，带来真实食评；发掘各区扫街名物，又相约居港多年外籍人士，到访经他们认证的家乡风味食肆；名厨食评家亦会带路搵食，带来专业推介节目精选美食新闻报道介绍的多间人气餐厅，力推当中招牌美食，并会速递美食优惠，让观众实时掌握最滋味抵食的饮食情报.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 殺人無數的劊子手葉常綠黃德斌為保護恩公的媳婦阮素心姚子羚順利產子，將素心安頓在京城享負盛名的穩婆花蕊紅邵美琪家中，因而遇上離奇命案，常綠竟以其鬼頭刀救活了一條小生命，誰料這名來歷不明的男嬰令常綠和蕊紅無故捲入朝廷的政治漩渦，一冷一熱的配搭化解了一次又一次的危機，兩人在患難中漸生情愫；另邊廂，一對同在妓院長大的小情侶赤知秋楊明和祝小滿龔嘉欣來到蕊紅家，苦苦哀求常綠收知秋為劊子手的學徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脫受刑，常綠遲疑不決，一名神秘的彩戲師司馬丑陳山聰出現，令各人關係陷入錯綜複雜，男嬰身分之謎更因而被逐步揭開，但同時敲起了死神的喪鐘.

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 千門八將的龍四鄭則仕飾被華探長文雄湯鎮業飾與大師兄龐峰秦沛飾設局陷害入獄，女友百合張慧儀飾更被文雄搶去五年後，龍四成為地位崇高的製片，有舒奇蔡瀚億飾麥基吳業坤飾兩位得力助手，還有一個剛相認的女兒小雨王子涵飾師弟唐偉黃栢文飾被殺，龍四鎖定其徒弟阿朗馬志威飾所為，二人賭枱上對決小雨向舞蹈老師百合傾訴暗戀新晉導演賀加俊何浩文飾，意外令百合龍四重逢百合偷去文雄的黑金帳簿準備私奔，文雄一怒下趕絕二人龍四押送入獄途中被神秘人劫走，他們正策劃一個捕獸籠，誓把隻手遮天的文雄引入內.

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家強林峯飾完成三年臥底任務後，回港開設沐足店，繼續收集情報刑事情報科總督察章紀孜黃智雯飾懷疑卓凱苗僑偉飾出獄後投入黑道，對他進行全面監視家強與卓凱捲入器官販賣案，聯同女臥底竇亞希蔡思貝飾及保安局調查官韋作榮馬國明飾，合力搗破涉案集團保安局及後新設安全情報機構，並邀得徐天堂袁偉豪飾加入，接管刑事情報科的工作覃歡喜許紹雄飾逃過一死後，暗中調查某社團的秘密神秘社團原來由長興已故龍頭魏德信的弟弟魏德禮創立，他還設下佈局，對家強卓凱等展開報復.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 大醬園 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Luna pengsan akibat panic attack apabila berjumpa dengan Areeq di Duncan Coffee. Sekali lagi Areeq terjumpa dengan Luna di klinik gigi, Areeq mulai menyampah dengan Luna yang dilihat terlalu obses mahu mendekatinya. Faiz pula dipukul oleh Mie abang Rysa kerana dikatakan mengambil kesempatan ke atas adiknya Rysa. programme.title: Pink Smile

Tuan Irsyad pula marahkan Luna kerana prestasi pelajarannya merosot, Luna terlalu banyak bergiat dengan NGO kebajikan sehingga membawa balik Irin seorang anak yatim ke rumahnnya.

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Melati mengherdik Luna kerana asyik ke Duncan Cafe untuk berjumpa dengan Areeq. Melati juga membuat fitnah kononnya Azhar, rakan sekerja mereka cuba mencabulnya. Areeq terpengaruh dan membuang Azhar. Selepas mendengar rintihan pekerjanya, Areeq percaya Melati sengaja membuat onak di cafenya. programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Rysa mengadu kepada abang angkatnya Areeq selepas Faiz memutuskan hubungan cinta mereka kerana Faiz bosan dengan sikap Rysa yang terlalu cemburu. Areeq terlupa temujanjinya dengan Luna, menyebabkan Luna berterusan mencari Areeq di Cafe. Masing-masing masih malu meluahkan perasaan, Luna kemudiannya membuka rahsia dia sukakanya Areeq. Manakala Tuan Irsyad asyik termenung memikirkan Irin yang dibawa oleh Luna ke rumah sebelum ini, dia pernah berjumpa dengan Irin sebelum ini.

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Luna mengekori Areeq mulai mesra selepas Areeq mengajar Luna membuat kek. Luna terjumpa layang-layang lama yang pernah dia bermain dengan Areeq satu ketika lalu. Luna membawa anak yatim dari rumah Titian Kasih untuk berbuka puasa di Duncan Cafe. Luna juga membuat kejutan untuk sambutan hari jadi Areeq di sana. Mereka bertukar-tukar hadiah. Faiz meminta perhubungan dengan Rysa ditangguhkan untuk sementara, Areeq mahu Rysa pura-pura melupakan Faiz untuk sementara waktu. Faiz mula rindukan Rysa.

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Azhar diterima semula bekerja di Duncan Cafe. Hubungan Areeq dengan Luna semakin mesra. Areeq mempunyai penyakit lupa, kali ini dia terlupa menyediakan makanan yang dipesan oleh Luna bagi sambutan hari jadi penghuni di Rumah Titian Kasih. Latar belakang Irin masih menjadi misteri sekalipun diketahui bapanya bernama Luqman, namun keluarganya masih belum ditemui. Satu hari, Luna ternampak Areeq bersama Rysa di kedai emas, mereka di lihat memilih cincin untuk perkahwinan

programme.title: Pink Smile
programme.desc: Luna syak Areeq dan Rysa mempunyai hubungan kekasih apabila ternampak mereka sedang memilih cincin di kedai emas. Manakala Rysa pula syak abang angkatnya itu telah jatuh cinta dengan Luna. Luna tidak lagi menghubungi dan berjumpa dengan Areeq. Namun Azrin meminta Luna berterus terang dengan Areeq. programme.desc: Aira sanggup terbang ke Wales demi membawa pulang tunangnya, Darwish. Namun setibanya di sana, dia mendapati Darwish sebenarnya memutuskan pertunangan kerana orang ketiga, Marissa. Dalam kecewa, Aira bertemu Jaka, jejaka Kelantan yang bekerja sebagai pencuci pinggan di sebuah kafe. Jaka kemudian bersetuju membantu Aira menawan kembali hati Darwish tetapi perjalanan itu membuka cerita yang tidak disangka.

programme.title: Black S1 EP6
programme.desc: Di Seri Setia, Black dan Sofia bekerjasama untuk menghalang satu pembunuhan yang berpotensi untuk berlaku. Semasa berada di sana, Black terimbas kembali masa lalu Malik, satu fenomena yang membingungkannya. Pemergian mereka ini juga merupakan titik perubahan cara Sofia melihat keupayaannya. Kesanggupan Sofia menggadaikan nyawanya untuk menyelamatkan nyawa orang lain memperbaharui tanggapan Black terhadapnya. Adakah cinta mula berputik? Black tertarik dan pada masa yang sama bingung dengan perasaannya terhadap Sofia, satu perasaan yang asing buat Black, seorang yang mementingkan diri. Tetapi hari yang bersinar menjadi pudar apabila Black kembali ke rumah dan mendapati bilik tersembunyi Malik telah digeledah dan dikosongkan. Sementara itu, pembunuh upahan telah meragut nyawa seorang lagi mangsa dan Detektif Borhan mendapati kematian itu ada kaitan dengan pembunuhan Nurul Najwa.

programme.title: Rampok
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. Tanpa disedari oleh pihak polis, salah seorang tebusan yang dibebaskan adalah rakan kepada perompak dan perompak itu sendiri. Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?

Dia perasan bahawa pembantu rumahnya, Bella telah hilang. Bella seperti adik kepada Nor dan dia tinggal bersama mereka. Suaminya mengatakan bahawa Bella telah kembali ke Amsterdam untuk berkahwin. Nor mengesyaki dan tidak lama kemudian anak-anaknya mula mempunyai kelakuan luar biasa. Anak pertama mereka suka bercakap dengan dirinya sendiri dan tidur di tempat yang rawak suaminya menyembunyikan rahsia manakala seorang wanita tua sentiasa memberi amaran kepada Nor. Tanpa disedari oleh Nor, Bella yang hilang mungkin sedang mengintai di sudut gelap banglo itu.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Tuah

Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Selepas mengetahui asal-usul sebenar dirinya sebagai anak luar nikah, Aurora kembali ke Malaysia untuk mencari ibu bapa kandungnya. Dalam perjalanan tersebut, dia dibantu oleh Khaliq dan mula mengenali erti keluarga, agama serta berdepan dengan dosa silam yang menghantui ibu bapanya.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia

programme.title: Taikun
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua lelaki bernama Tai dan Kun, sahabat baik yang hanya meminati pergaduhan dan mencuri. Apabila tabiat buruk mereka menyebabkan mereka bertembung dan memukul teruk ahli geng Pink dan Purple, Tai dan Kun kemudian direkrut oleh ketua geng yang kagum dengan kemahiran mereka.

programme.title: Istanbul Aku Datang
programme.desc: Seorang gadis muda dari Malaysia pergi ke Istanbul untuk bertemu dengan teman lelaki kesayangannya, namun gadis yang naif itu tidak tahu apa yang akan berlaku kepada kehidupannya di sana.

programme.title: Magika
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua beradik, Ayu dan Malik, yang secara tidak sengaja masuk ke dunia ajaib bernama Magika ketika cuba menyelamatkan roh ibu mereka. Di dunia itu, mereka bertemu watak-watak dongeng Melayu seperti Nenek Kebayan dan Badang, sambil berjuang mencari jalan pulang ke dunia nyata.

programme.title: Ruang Temu

programme.title: Terima Kasih Cikgu
programme.desc: Kisah Amar, seorang doktor yang ditugaskan di sebuah hospital. Suatu hari, Amar bertemu dengan bekas gurunya, Cikgu Azman. Selepas bersara, Cikgu Azman disahkan menghidap penyakit kanser. Amar cuba merawat gurunya sebaik mungkin.

programme.title: Temen Kondangan
programme.desc: Putri yang sering menghadiri majlis perkahwinan seorang diri akhirnya menyewa seorang lelaki untuk menjadi teman menghadiri majlis. Namun, hubungan yang pada mulanya sekadar lakonan bertukar menjadi lebih rumit apabila perasaan sebenar mula muncul.

programme.title: 7 Days24 Hours
programme.desc: Mengisahkan pasangan suami isteri, Tania dan Tyo, yang terlalu sibuk dengan kerjaya sehingga hubungan mereka semakin renggang. Selepas kedua-duanya jatuh sakit dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital yang sama, mereka akhirnya mempunyai masa bersama selama 7 hari 24 jam untuk memperbaiki hubungan, memahami satu sama lain dan menghadapi masalah yang selama ini dipendam.

Hal ini telah menyebabkan konflik dan ketegangan dalam hubungan mereka yang menguji kekuatan cinta dan komitment mereka.

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.title: Want To De-stress

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5

Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the Try It Out Team, returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the islands heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the shows spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the citys corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2
programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the heart-fluttering light and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates.

programme.title: Star Weekly

With so much surrounding information, the show features a special Fact Check segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: J Music 2026

Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly

While things seem to be falling apart, this dinner may well be an opportunity to mend relations.

As a bounty of 100 million Hong Kong dollars is made to hunt down the biggest drug dealer in the city, Hong Kong becomes the battleground for the fight between good and evil.

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba is forced to work at home during COVID-19 and fights with his family every day. He decides to turn his mothers chilli sauce into a trendy commodity to keep his family occupied. With his mother, father and aunt making the chilli sauce together, the family sells it online and the business grows beyond their imagination.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica downloads a dating app for fun. Little does she know that the charming French engineer on the other end is actually a local con artist named Joe, who is a member of an online scam group. As their fake relationship unfolds, both Joes guilty conscience and Veronicas hopes intensify.

programme.title: Everything Is Unknown
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming receives his fathers will stating that he must attend his funeral at home to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he encounters his ex-girlfriend, her husband Hua Qi and his daughter whom he has never met. When Pan discovers that his daughter is being abused by Hua, he vows to save her but eventually fall into their trap

programme.title: Demi-Haunted
programme.desc: Wan Fei is a promising Chinese Opera singer who is secretly in love with a man named Jiang Hao Feng. She wants to sing for him on stage but dies mid-song in a tragic accident. Years later, Wan Feis ghost returns, and finds that part of her spirit has been reincarnated in the form of Chor Bai, a young Chinese Opera singer. This finally allows Wan Fei to fulfill her wish

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: Three devastated parents, pushed to the edge by the abduction of their children, forge a fierce alliance in the barren deserts. Driven by fury and grief, they embark on a lawless, violent crusade to hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate. Can they shatter the criminal ring and bring their children home alive?

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Measure in Love
programme.desc: A massive earthquake splits the world into two regions where time flows at different speeds. During a medical relief mission, student An Qing meets Shu Zai, and an extraordinary bond begins. Yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged, forcing them to confront a love challenged by time, distance, and fate.

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called The Venoms, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because its also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques. The Five Venom alumnus and Chang Cheh discovery, Lo Meng, teams up with Liu Chia-liang protege Wang Yu, as they inadvertently turn from vagabond kung-fu school operators into anti-Ching, patriotic fighters.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hungs relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhous favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission?

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the familys young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huos stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Huis husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders, it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dongs songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his fathers death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the mens help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: Bottle Radha
programme.desc: Radha Mani, a mason addicted to alcohol, puts his family through misery. Even after his wife admits him to a rehabilitation centre, his destructive habits continue worsening.

programme.title: Goli Soda
programme.desc: In Koyambedu market, four carefree coolie boys start a mess to earn respect and identity, transforming their lives and friendships along the way.

programme.title: Brindavanam
programme.desc: romantic comedy film starring N. T. Rama Rao Jr., Kajal Aggarwal and Samantha

programme.title: Pheonix
programme.desc: Young Surya, accused of political murder, endures deadly plots in a juvenile reform school while struggling to survive the brutal realities of life behind bars daily.

programme.title: KGF: Chapter 2
programme.desc: Rocky successfully rises as the leader and saviour of the people of the Kolar Gold Fields. But, in his goal to fulfil his mothers wishes, Rocky must tackle Adheera, Inayat Khalil and Ramika Sen.

programme.title: DD Returns
programme.desc: Sathish and his friends stash stolen cash in a haunted mansion, only to be trapped in a deadly ghostly game when they return to retrieve it.

programme.title: Irumbu Thirai
programme.desc: A military officer borrows money for his sisters marriage using fake papers. When the money goes missing from his account, he embarks on an investigation that uncovers a hacker.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: India Pakistan
programme.desc: Two aspiring lawyers, not knowing that both are of the same profession, share the same office. Things take a turn when they work on the same case.

programme.title: Yaman
programme.desc: After losing his father to a bunch of scheming politicians, a young man decides to wade into the corrupt and unscrupulous world of politics to avenge his death.

programme.title: Nerkonda Paarvai
programme.desc: A retired veteran lawyer returns to defend three women falsely accused in a criminal case, facing powerful enemies and patriarchal biases in court.

programme.title: Love Insurance Kompany
programme.desc: A man who believes in old-school love meets Dheema, a woman embracing tech-driven romance. Their growing relationship challenges modern love norms and pits them against Suriyan, a powerful CEO of a lo

programme.title: Maragadha Naanayam
programme.desc: A king received a blessed coin, the Maragadha Naanayam, granting him power. After his death, the coin causes a string of deaths. A man takes the challenge to retrieve it.

programme.title: Rekka
programme.desc: A young man, known for helping couples elope, is forced by a gangster to kidnap a politicians daughter after he stops the wedding of a girl who didnt want to marry him.

programme.title: Land Of Primates

programme.title: Land Of Primates

programme.desc: In the cool highlands near Australias Snowy Mountains is Wombat Wood. There, dotted amongst the trees and dense foliage, are over a hundred wombat burrows. But when some of the burrows are flooded, the wombats need to find safety.

Rooted on the savannah of Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate.

programme.title: Wildlife ER

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Shadow vet Bec, who patches up dog-bitten koala Rachel, and new vets Ruby and Kerryn, who soothe a pack of itchy possums. Free a pair of kookaburras trapped in a wall with rescue officer Dani and watch vet Tims squirrel glider knee surgery.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Chase the team as they triage patients from a hoarding case, then free a tangled-up ibis with rescue officers Jo and Chantelle. Check on a baby koala that took a swan dive with vet Mel and play the waiting game with a deadly eastern brown snake.

programme.title: 13 Hours To Survive
programme.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

programme.title: 13 Hours To Survive
programme.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: At the waters edge a brave group of male penguins gather, preparing to make the dangerous journey ashore. With many threats ahead, there is safety in number and these petite penguins have important business to attend. Its time to breed and they must find a burrow before the females arrive.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: New Zealands West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wilderness hides a host of endemic animals. Evolutionary castaways, every one of them is a rare ecological jewel. From alpine parrots and shy penguins to mammal-like kiwis and ancient eels. To survive the conditions the wildlife here has to be hardy, cunning and resourceful. A journey along the West Coast reveals the beauty of this land, and the trials and tribulations of the wildlife that live here.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries and the life that thrives within them.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: Spring on New Zealands east coast is a time of promise for the New Zealand Fur Seal and the Norther Royal Albatross. Theyve returned to their land to breed. But harsh terrain, fickle weather and hungry predators will conspire to make lives difficult for them. Only the strongest will survive to carry forward their legacy.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: New Zealands isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Lilliputian predators and tiny terrors that lead remarkable lives, where every hunter is also the hunted and survival is always a giant struggle. Journey into the undergrowth and discover life on a different scale. From giant carnivorous centipedes and nocturnal crickets to fishing spiders and glowing worms with silken traps. Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealands Creepiest Crawlies.

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that hes not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, When I was your age... Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didnt go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, When I was your age, gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 政府近年投放多了人手，亦使用不同新工具捉老鼠，但有市民說經常有老鼠入屋李生和女兒住在深水埗一個劏房單位，他說大廈附近一直有老鼠出沒，但今年二月開始，大廈停止安排清潔工晚上清理垃圾，吸引了大量老鼠，經常有老鼠沿著水渠從窗口進入家中；他今年在家中捉了十多隻老鼠，令他感到很大壓力你看到牠的皮膚潰爛，是否有病菌？如果觸碰到牠，或將牠咬過的食物煮來吃，會否傳染病毒給自己，會否死掉？食環署指，由於鼠隻對食物的喜好，會因應時間和地點而有所不同，現時會在鼠籠放置燒味紅腸蘋果魷魚等，作為捕捉老鼠的誘餌；但有滅鼠專家實地觀察，不少食環署鼠籠都是使用蕃薯作為誘餌，認為效果可能未如理想，例如有些蕃薯已發霉，加上後巷有食肆，廚餘比蕃薯更能吸引老鼠，專家建議可以多做一步，先將蕃薯烤焗加熱，讓糖份發揮出來，效果會更好政府前年推出統計老鼠出沒頻率的新方法，以無鼠百分比作為新的鼠患指數食環署使用熱能探測攝錄機，於調查地點連續三天，從晚上七時到翌日早上七時，每兩分鐘拍攝一次熱成像照片；但根據滅蟲業界人士的觀察，現時攝錄機只會放在政府管轄的公眾地方，認為無鼠百分比指數，未能完整地覆蓋和反映不同地點的鼠患情況，一些私人地方，甚至已出租的食環署物業，都監察不了無鼠百分比以照片數目作為單位計算，立法會議員陳凱欣認為，數字未能反映實際鼠患情況一張照片裡有二十隻老鼠，比起只有一隻兩隻，問題嚴重很多，但也只是計算作一張照片，便會低估情況究竟，香港距離無鼠城市有多遠？

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: 금수미앙

programme.title: 대한민국을 바꾼 법의 탄생 : 헌법을 말하다
광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 동시방영작여성향 게임 세계는 모브에게 가혹한 세계입니다2
아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

Lyn amula mengundur diri dari Bulan kerana salah faham. Lyna suka pada Ayden. Lyna turut merosakkan Sape peninggalan mendiang ibu Bulan. Bulan mengharapkan Lyna akan hadir semasa dia membuat persembahan nanti. Bulan terus tabah dan telah berjaya membuat persembahan sulungnya di World Traditional Music Perfomance.Pelakon: Justina Usun George Bulan, Putei Nur urratu Ain Lyna, Rani Labak Nenek Imba, Adam Thian Ayden, Muhammad Fareez Ryan
